correctness.rationale: For q=p^f and cyclic scalar H of order m>1 dividing q-1, H acts freely on nonzero additive characters; induction from each (q-1)/m orbit yields degree m. The induced kernel is the trace annihilator of a*span_Fp(H)=a*F_(p^e), e=ord_m(p), of size p^(f-e), hence codegree p^e. Linear characters factor through cyclic abelianization C_m and contribute (d,phi(d)), d|m. Since p^e>m the top two codegrees and top multiplicity recover m and q. No assertion for arbitrary nonscalar Frobenius groups. Finite-field verification script and frozen RESULT.md read; independently checked character-theoretic and subfield arguments.

value.rationale: The complete codegree-with-multiplicity classification gives positive rigidity for a natural infinite solvable family even though unrestricted group pseudo-algebra rigidity fails. The nonlinear codegree recovers the subfield generated by a cyclic complement, and its multiplicity recovers the size of ambient field; not a mere relabeling of character degrees.
